training_statistics: Measured std and lag-1 AC on 60000 retained target samples.
test_statistics: Existing selected test coordinates unchanged; sigma grid uses the original training-stat regression.
warmup: 100 target samples from nearest training Q1; original prefix endpoints1500,5500,9500; displayed end9500. Not target test trajectory warm-up.
closed_loop: 10000 steps, including all initial predicted samples; no feeding after warm-up. Constant conditioning, including post; no special post hold/ramp.
exclusion: Exclude entire measured prefix if any nonfinite sample or V<=0.30; record later recovery separately. Threshold crossing does not imply permanent collapse.
rate: 35 uniform Q1 points2.989620..2.989960,10 warm-up windows per point,2000 steps. Original Q1-to-std linear regression followed by original std-to-AC regression; no post ramp. This is a uniform conditioning protocol, unlike the older piecewise-input/ramped rate.
gt_rate: Packaged reference_survival.csv gt_survival_rate interpolated to Q1; not recomputed; its evaluation horizon is not established by this file.
gt_trajectory: Existing ODE CSV retained at identical test Q1; length2000. These GT runs are not phase-aligned to the reference-training warm-up signal.
selection: User-approved longer-training candidate based on precritical reconstruction. New post/rate outputs are diagnostic, not selection targets.
